payload.name: Preserve Distinct Events During Memory Update
payload.description: When updating or merging an event memory with new evidence that describes a different occurrence of the same activity, use this to keep both events separate.
content: During UPDATE or MERGE of an event memory, compare the new evidence's time and ordinal (e.g., 'first', 'regional', 'fourth') with the existing memory. If they describe distinct occurrences, do not overwrite the existing content; keep the original event and add a separate event memory for the new one.

Only update/replace the existing memory when the new evidence clearly refers to the same occurrence. If times or ordinals differ, preserve the original event's who/what/date and record the new event with its own date.
Stop once the original event and the new event are each represented in a memory; do not add unrelated details.

solves: Prevents losing an earlier event when new evidence describes a different occurrence of the same activity; an UPDATE or MERGE must not overwrite a distinct past event with a newer one.
